name: X-ray repair cross complementing 2
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: XRCC2 encodes DNA repair protein XRCC2. Annotated molecular activities include ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.
